parameters.name: AlertOnPartialComplete
parameters.description: Specifies whether to trigger an alert for partially completed jobs. This parameter takes effect only for local File Backup and ECS File Backup Essential Edition.

parameters.name: DataNetworkType
parameters.description:
The data plane access point type. Valid values:
* **PUBLIC**: public network
* **VPC**: VPC network
* **CLASSIC**: classic network

parameters.name: DataProxySetting
parameters.description:
The data plane proxy setting. Valid values:
* **DISABLE**: does not use a proxy.
* **USE\_CONTROL\_PROXY** (default): uses the same configuration as the control plane.
* **CUSTOM**: uses a custom configuration (HTTP protocol).

parameters.name: MaxCpuCore
parameters.description: The number of CPU cores used by a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit.

parameters.name: MaxMemory
parameters.description: The maximum memory that the client can use, in bytes. Only version 2.13.0 and later are supported.

parameters.name: MaxWorker
parameters.description: The number of concurrent workers for a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit.

parameters.name: ProxyHost
parameters.description: The IP address of the custom data plane proxy server host.

parameters.name: ProxyPassword
parameters.description: The password of the custom data plane proxy server.

parameters.name: ProxyPort
parameters.description: The port of the custom data plane proxy server host.

parameters.name: ProxyUser
parameters.description: The username of the custom data plane proxy server.

parameters.name: UseHttps
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use HTTPS to transmit data plane data.

- true: Uses HTTPS for transmission.
- false: Uses HTTP for transmission.

parameters.name: VaultId
parameters.description: The backup vault ID. This parameter is required for legacy clients.
